certificates.method: elimination with case distinctions (mero.wsolve.tri_solve): products split, linear unknowns solved for with the cases coefficient != 0 / = 0, pseudo-division; 11 steps
trace: [1] product: one case for each factor of (q2) * (-4*b0*q2 + q1**2) -> cases 1.1, 1.2
[1.1] solve q2 = 0 for q2 (coefficient 1 != 0): q2 = 0
[1.1] solve q1 = 0 for q1 (coefficient 1 != 0): q1 = 0
[1.1] solve b0 = 0 for b0 (coefficient 1 != 0): b0 = 0
[1.1] product: one case for each factor of (b1 + 6) * (b1 + 4) -> cases 1.1.1, 1.1.2
[1.1.1] solve b1 + 6 = 0 for b1 (coefficient 1 != 0): b1 = -6
[1.1.1] case finished: no equation left -> case 1 of the solution set
